blocks.title: Processing Community Day
blocks.text: Started in 2017, Processing Community Day (PCD) is a global network of community-led events that bring together the open-source community to celebrate art, code, and creative tools.

images.caption: Live-coding performance by 2024 Processing Foundation Fellow Roxanne Harris (alsoknownasrox) and Kat Zhang (The Poet Engineer).

blocks.title: PCD Through The Years
blocks.body: From Tokyo to Santiago, there have been over 120 PCD events hosted around the world.
